forecast.generalSituationZh: 一股達強風程度的東北季候風會在未來一兩日為華南帶來晴朗及非常乾燥的天氣，內陸地區日夜溫差頗大。預料季候風會在下週初逐漸緩和，同時高空反氣旋會為華南帶來大致良好的天氣。受一股偏東氣流影響，下週中後期廣東沿岸溫暖，天氣漸轉潮濕。
forecast.generalSituationEn: A strong northeast monsoon will bring fine and very dry weather to southern China in the next couple of days. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over inland areas. The monsoon is expected to moderate gradually early next week. Meanwhile, an anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to southern China. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be warm and the weather will become humid over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
